name: Pi BIN client
description: Raspberry-Pi-side client that consumes the 4-bpp .bin frame. Subscribes to tesserae/pi_bin/frame/bin; publishes a heartbeat with idle/rendering state and the last paint timestamp. REST-polled instances also honour sleep_interval_s — Tesserae echoes the configured cadence back in the /api/v1/device/<id>/status response as next_poll_s so the client knows when to wake.

sleep_interval_s.label: Sleep interval
sleep_interval_s.help: How long the client sleeps between frame fetches when polling via REST. MQTT-driven instances ignore this value (they wake on retained-frame publishes). Custom value is in seconds.
